power.ibarnorigins.sandman_attributes.de: Lukan teqqimeḍ ɣef uẓekka n uẓekka, tesεiḍ cwiṭ n lbaṭel, maca ɣas 50% n lbaṭel i tesεiḍ deg wayen ur telli ara d uẓekka.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.name: Aẓekka n uẓekka

power.ibarnorigins.soulfire_strength.des: Ssarem 50% n lbaṭel i d-yettunefken mi ara teqqimeḍ ɣer iẓuran n tmes n wemdan neɣ mi ara teṭṭfeḍ tiɣawsiwin-nsen.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_fireweakness: Ɣas akken tettḥulfuḍ iman-ik akken ilaq ger tmes n tmes, tmes n tmes n tmes d tmes n tmes i k-id-yeǧǧan ad tesɛu azal ameqran. D ayagi i k-yeǧǧan daɣen ad tesɛuḍ 100% n lbaṭel i d-yeǧǧan tmes n tmes n tmes.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_piglinfear.d: Tasfiḥt n yizerfan imezwura i d-yeffɣen deg-k tessekker tugdi deg yal yiwen ma ur d win i d-yeddren mliḥ.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_vegetarian.d: Aẓekka ur tesεi ara aṭas n tesraft n tudert am tneẓra. S wakka, aẓekka ur tesεi ara aṭas, maca tneẓra tesεi-d tajmilt deg tečča-s s wudem n wamek i d-teččur.
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.name: Homing Wither Skull
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.descripti: Ssarem iǧehdan n lmegtin ur yemmuten, ad d-teffɣem iɣallen i d-yeffɣen i wid i d-yeṭṭfen fell-akent.
power.ibarnorigins.wp_item_prevention.de: Ur tezmireḍ ara ad tesseḍ kra n taɛrabt i yugaren taɛrabt n ddheb.
